condition: Large polyp removed piecemeal — early site-check colonoscopy
permutationLabel: 30 mm lesion removed piecemeal by EMR
summary: 67-year-old woman after piecemeal EMR of a 30 mm laterally spreading tubulovillous adenoma in the ascending colon. MSTF 2020: site-check colonoscopy at 6 months; BSG 2020: site check at 2–6 months (not 3 years).

inputs.chiefComplaint: Follow-up after removal of a large bowel polyp
inputs.hpi: Colonoscopy 4 weeks ago for a positive FIT: 30 mm granular laterally spreading lesion in the ascending colon removed piecemeal by endoscopic mucosal resection (6 pieces), margins treated with snare-tip soft coagulation, site tattooed. Histology: tubulovillous adenoma, low-grade dysplasia, no invasive cancer. No other polyps. Recovered well.

imaging.name: Colonoscopy
imaging.result: 30 mm LST-G ascending colon, piecemeal EMR in 6 pieces, margins treated with STSC, tattoo placed distally. No residual lesion visible.

surgicalHistory: Piecemeal EMR ascending colon (4 weeks ago)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Large (30 mm) tubulovillous adenoma removed piecemeal by EMR
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: 30 mm tubulovillous adenoma (LGD) removed piecemeal by EMR. Site-check colonoscopy at 6 months for residual/recurrent adenoma, then 1 year later.

mustInclude.note: Piecemeal resection of a lesion ≥ 20 mm: early site check for residual/recurrent adenoma (MSTF 6 months; BSG 2–6 months).

mustExclude.note: A 3-year first interval misses residual adenoma after piecemeal EMR.

guideline.name: US Multi-Society Task Force — recommendations for follow-up after colonoscopy and polypectomy
guideline.section: 1–2 tubular adenomas < 10 mm completely removed: repeat colonoscopy in 7–10 years; adenoma ≥ 20 mm removed piecemeal: repeat colonoscopy (site check) at 6 months
guideline.citation: Gupta S, Lieberman D, Anderson JC, et al. Recommendations for follow-up after colonoscopy and polypectomy: a consensus update by the US Multi-Society Task Force on Colorectal Cancer. Gastroenterology. 2020;158:1131–1153.

guideline.name: BSG/ACPGBI/PHE post-polypectomy and post-colorectal cancer resection surveillance guidelines
guideline.section: Low-risk findings (no high-risk criteria): no colonoscopic surveillance — return to population screening when invited; high-risk findings: one-off surveillance at 3 years; large non-pedunculated polyp (≥ 20 mm) removed piecemeal: site-check colonoscopy at 2–6 months
guideline.citation: Rutter MD, East J, Rees CJ, et al. British Society of Gastroenterology/Association of Coloproctology of Great Britain and Ireland/Public Health England post-polypectomy and post-colorectal cancer resection surveillance guidelines. Gut. 2020;69:201–223.

rationale: Residual or recurrent adenoma after piecemeal EMR is common; both guidelines require an early site-check colonoscopy rather than the standard high-risk 3-year interval.
